component.name: SoundSplitter
component.summary: Route stereo channels to separate audio devices
将立体声的左右声道输出到不同音频设备

description.p: SoundSplitter turns two separate audio output devices into a stereo pair by routing the left channel to one device and the right channel to the other.
SoundSplitter 将立体声的左声道和右声道分别输出到两个音频设备，将它们组合为一对立体声音箱。
Adjust each channel's delay independently to compensate for differences in device latency. The application provides volume and mute controls, saved settings, and a system tray interface.
可独立调整各声道的延迟，以补偿设备之间的延迟差。程序提供音量和静音控制、设置保存及系统托盘功能。
